title: Index-derived KeyInfo P4 attachment

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeSetP4KeyInfo derives KeyInfo from an Index and transfers a successful result to the most recently emitted VDBE operation as P4_KEYINFO while preserving parse-error and allocation-failure no-attachment behavior.

external_source_responsibilities: sqlite3KeyInfoOfIndex collation, sort-order, allocation, and corruption handling
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete conditional attachment wrapper is assigned; broader index code-generation integration remains open.

inputs: Parse with a non-null VDBE and non-null Index
outputs: Latest VDBE operation owns derived KeyInfo P4 on success; no operation mutation on derivation failure
contracts.ownership: Successful KeyInfo ownership transfers to VDBE P4; failed derivation retains no owner.
contracts.state_and_results: Existing parse errors and KeyInfo allocation/collation failures suppress attachment without adding a second result path.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns connection serialization; no callbacks or direct I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Null KeyInfo leaves the operation array unchanged and preserves the derivation owner's parse/connection error.

representation_differences: Typed Parse, Index, VDBE, and KeyInfo pointers replace C casts; the P4 tag is the generated active-profile keyinfo constant.

oracle.protocol: Invoke attachment with an existing parse error and observe no operation mutation; compile-trace successful derivation into the typed P4 owner pending a pinned-C positive-path trace.
oracle.normalization: Pointer values are owner identities only; P4 tags and scalar state are exact.

assurance.oom: KeyInfo OOM returns null and suppresses attachment; allocator behavior belongs to sqlite3KeyInfoOfIndex.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller serialization remains external.
assurance.malformed_input: Null VDBE or Index violates source assertions.
assurance.continuation: Success leaves KeyInfo under VDBE ownership; failure preserves parser continuation state.
assurance.performance: One KeyInfo derivation and constant-time latest-operation attachment.

integration.native_call_path: The typed owner is compile- and error-branch unit-traced; index generation dispatch remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires positive-path trace, caller integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect ordinary index operation generation to this owner.

callers: Index seek/open code generation after emitting the target opcode
Source-layout error-branch unit trace invokes the owner directly
assertions_branches_cleanup: Both source non-null assertions and the conditional KeyInfo branch are assigned
Successful attachment transfers ownership; failed derivation does not append or mutate P4
upstream_tests: Upstream index, collation, schema-corruption, and OOM tests cover this wrapper
Project unit trace covers existing-parse-error no-attachment
